rules.sentence: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is a rare genetic cardiac channelopathy characterized by unexplained syncopal episodes and sudden cardiac death (SCD) in patients with a structurally normal heart.
These symptoms occur in the context of adrenergically mediated polymorphic ventricular arrhythmias, which are often triggered by emotional or physical stress.
The inconspicuous presentation of CPVT poses challenges in diagnosis, therefore maintaining a high level of suspicion and familiarity with this condition is crucial.

CPVT is one of the most prevalent genetically identifiable causes of sudden unexplained death in individuals aged 1–35 years, especially in cases where autopsy results do not reveal structural heart defects.
CPVT is considered responsible for up to 15% of unexplained SCD in young people.
